title: ICAO space weather advisory
description: An ICAO space weather advisory for international air navigation in the fixed line layout (SWX ADVISORY, DTG, SWXC, ADVISORY NR, SWX EFFECT, OBS SWX, FCST SWX +6 HR to +24 HR, RMK, NXT ADVISORY). Effects are HF COM, GNSS, RADIATION or SATCOM at MOD or SEV. The layout follows the ICAO Annex 3 example and should be checked against the current edition. Written by a space weather center for dispatchers and air traffic services.

dtg.description: Date and time of issue as YYYYMMDD/HHMMZ.

swxc.description: Name of the issuing space weather center.

effect.description: Space weather effect and severity, such as HF COM MOD, GNSS MOD, RADIATION SEV, SATCOM MOD, joined with AND.
examples: HF COM MOD AND GNSS MOD

obs.description: Observed space weather: day and time, latitude band and longitude range, and flight level for radiation.

forecasts.description: The four forecast lines, +6, +12, +18 and +24 hours.

text.description: Day and time then the same band layout, or NO SWX EXP.

rmk.description: Remark in capital letters; state that the exercise is not real.
examples: GEOMAGNETIC STORM IN PROGRESS. EXERCISE ADVISORY.

nextAdvisory.description: Next advisory time or WILL BE ISSUED BY.
